name: Build and simulate an AND circuit
description: Verifies users can place, move, connect, and simulate circuit nodes.
steps: Place an AND gate and two input switches
Drag a node to a new location
Connect both switches to the gate and the gate to the LED
expected: Nodes move smoothly, wires stay attached to circular ports, and the LED turns ON only when both inputs are ON.

name: Use the editor on mobile
description: Checks circuit editing remains usable on a narrow touchscreen.
steps: Drag it to a different position
expected: The gate remains visible at its new position and the palette remains accessible.

name: Remove wires and components
description: Verifies wires and nodes can be removed without leaving broken connections.
steps: Select a wire by clicking its line
expected: The selected wire disappears and removing a node also removes all attached wires.

name: Place IC and display nodes
description: Checks IC and display nodes expose the correct number of connection ports.
steps: Add a 74HC08 chip and a seven-segment display
Connect an output to the display
expected: The chip and display appear with circular ports and their logic state updates.
